rationale: The workflow already implements the key supported optimizations: dependency caching is provided by `setup-uv` with `enable-cache: true` and `cache-dependency-glob: pyproject.toml` (covering the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE dependency-cache direction), and concurrency with `cancel-in-progress` for pull requests already covers P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE for PRs. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is contraindicated because both jobs set `continue-on-error: true`, so matrix failures do not fail the job and `fail-fast` would never trigger; removing `continue-on-error` would reduce intended matrix coverage. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative successful-duration history from the provided CI history (no run durations are available). No other pattern's preconditions are met: there is no Bazel build, no scheduled workflow, no test-selection dependency data, and no unused outputs identified.
